title: Skullcapflavone II Suppresses Colorectal Cancer by Inhibiting the HIF-1alpha-Glycolysis Pathway.
authors: Yang, Shiwei; Hu, Wenqi; Xin, Xuezhi; Zhang, Guang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物SFII通过泛素化降解HIF-1α抑制结直肠癌糖酵解，仅涉及药物-蛋白作用，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Our aim is to explore Skullcapflavone II (SFII) function in colorectal cancer and delineate its relevant mechanisms. Malignant behaviors of HCT-116 and SW480 cells were assessed using colony formation, 5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine staining, Annexin V/propidium iodide double staining, scratch and transwell assays. Changes in glycolysis were assessed by seahorse assay and western blot. The potential mechanism by which SFII inhibited the expression of hypoxia-inducible transcription factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) was explored in vitro by molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, western blot, immunofluorescence, cycloheximide chase assay, ubiquitination assay, and some rescue experiments. Besides, a xenograft model was performed to verify SFII function on colorectal cancer. We found that SFII inhibited the malignant behavior and glycolysis of colorectal cancer cells. Furthermore, SFII inhibited HIF-1alpha protein level in colorectal cancer cells via enhancing its ubiquitination. Moreover, HIF-1alpha overexpression attenuated SFII effect on the malignant behavior and glycolysis in colorectal cancer cells. In vivo, SFII inhibited tumorigenesis through repressing the HIF-1alpha-glycolysis pathway in BALB/c nude mice. SFII could suppress proliferation, migration, and invasion in colorectal cancer through inhibiting the HIF-1alpha-glycolysis pathway.
abstract_zh: 我们的目标是探讨黄芩素II（Skullcapflavone II, SFII）在结直肠癌中的作用，并阐明其相关机制。通过集落形成、5-乙炔基-2'-脱氧尿苷染色、Annexin V/碘化丙啶双染、划痕和transwell实验评估HCT-116和SW480细胞的恶性行为。通过海马分析和蛋白质印迹评估糖酵解变化。通过分子对接、表面等离子体共振、定量逆转录聚合酶链反应、蛋白质印迹、免疫荧光、环己酰亚胺追踪实验、泛素化实验及一些拯救实验，在体外探讨SFII抑制缺氧诱导转录因子-1α（HIF-1α）表达的潜在机制。此外，进行异种移植模型以验证SFII对结直肠癌的作用。我们发现SFII抑制了结直肠癌细胞的恶性行为和糖酵解。进一步地，SFII通过增强HIF-1α的泛素化来抑制其在结直肠癌细胞中的蛋白水平。此外，HIF-1α过表达减弱了SFII对结直肠癌细胞恶性行为和糖酵解的影响。在体内，SFII通过抑制BALB/c裸鼠中的HIF-1α-糖酵解通路来抑制肿瘤发生。SFII可通过抑制HIF-1α-糖酵解通路来抑制结直肠癌的增殖、迁移和侵袭。
